research_question: How much of the continuous-ECG gap is beat timing rather than beat morphology? A fixed training-fold template beat is placed at different sources of R-peak timing and scored exactly like the models.
no_training: No model is trained, tuned or selected. Inputs are training-fold labels and the frozen test predictions of the matched benchmark.
template: per fold, the mean of every complete R-to-R cycle in the TRAINING fold, raw (per-record z-scored) ECG resampled to 200 samples; no radar, no test data
synthesis: for each test window, the template is resampled to each interval between consecutive R peaks and written into that interval; the partial cycles before the first and after the last peak use the template resampled to the window's median RR (training-fold median RR if fewer than two peaks), aligned so they end or start on the peak; a window with no peaks is set to the training-fold mean value and counted as a failure

timing_sources.T0_gt: ground-truth R peaks -- ORACLE timing, an upper bound that uses test labels and is never achievable performance
timing_sources.T1_remnet_event_head: peaks from REM-Net's event-head probability (peaks_from_heatmap), a radar-only readout
timing_sources.T2_remnet_waveform: peaks detected on REM-Net's reconstructed waveform (detect_rpeaks), radar-only
timing_sources.T3_chen_tcn_waveform: peaks detected on Chen-TCN's reconstructed waveform, the strongest matched baseline, radar-only

metrics: the frozen evaluator functions of scripts/train_continuous_ecg_pilot: waveform_metrics, smoothing_diagnostics, region_errors, waveform-derived F1 from timing_metrics; window-macro within fold, fold-macro with population std over 11 folds
comparisons: paired two-sided Wilcoxon on 11 fold values, each template variant versus REM-Net's own continuous output, plus folds won; descriptive, uncorrected
pre_declared_readings: If T0 is far above every model, beat timing is the dominant bottleneck of continuous reconstruction.
If T1 or T2 is statistically indistinguishable from REM-Net's own output, REM-Net's morphology adds nothing measurable beyond a template placed at its own beats.
If T1 or T2 is significantly above REM-Net's own output, REM-Net's reconstructed waveform is worse than a template placed at its own beats.
If T1 or T2 is significantly below REM-Net's own output, REM-Net's waveform carries morphology information beyond the template.
